easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 3.
description:
Cast Timeline Culler either from your hand or from your graveyard for its warp cost by paying {B} and 2 life.
When Timeline Culler enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain 2 life. 
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Timeline Culler, adding {B}.
Repeat.
